stops.title: Branch Sɛtin
stops.caption: Infɔmeshɔn, skɛjul, chɛk-in.
stops.speech: Wan branch kɛr in adrɛs, in sɛvis skɛjul, ɛn if sɛf chɛk-in de ɔn ɛn fɔ omɔch tɛm rawnd di sɛvis.

stops.title: Udat de Lid am
stops.caption: Pasto, minista, admin.
stops.speech: Dɛn de gi lidaship ya: di mayn pasto, ɛni minista, ɛn di branch admin dɛn we kin manej in data.
